Project: duckdb-sqlalchemy
Summary: DuckDB SQLAlchemy dialect for DuckDB and MotherDuck. Supports SQLAlchemy Core and ORM APIs with pooling defaults, type mappings, COPY helpers, and MotherDuck connection helpers.

Key entry points:
- sqlalchemy.create_engine("duckdb://...")
- duckdb_sqlalchemy.URL and duckdb_sqlalchemy.MotherDuckURL
- duckdb_sqlalchemy.create_motherduck_engine and create_engine_from_paths
- duckdb_sqlalchemy table functions (read_parquet, read_csv, table_function)
- duckdb_sqlalchemy COPY helpers (copy_from_parquet, copy_from_csv, copy_from_rows, copy_to_parquet)
- duckdb_sqlalchemy.checkpoint
- MotherDuck SQL function helpers (md_list_dives, md_get_guide, md_list_flights, prompt_jev, ...)

Behavior notes:
- Reflection without a schema covers the current database and schema; pass schema="db.schema" for attached databases
- result.rowcount reports rows changed by INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE
- regexp_match compiles to regexp_matches() (substring match)
- DuckDB has no SAVEPOINT, no SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, and cannot add UNIQUE, FOREIGN KEY, or CHECK constraints to an existing table
- Alembic needs a DefaultImpl subclass with __dialect__ = "duckdb" (see alembic.html)

Docs (https://leonardovida.github.io/duckdb-sqlalchemy/):
- getting-started.html
- overview.html
- connection-urls.html
- motherduck.html
- configuration.html
- olap.html
- pandas-jupyter.html
- types-and-caveats.html
- alembic.html
- migration-from-duckdb-engine.html

Compatibility:
- Python 3.10+
- SQLAlchemy 2.0.0+ on Python <3.14; 2.0.45+ on Python 3.14+; SQLAlchemy 2.1 requires Python 3.11+
- DuckDB 1.3.0+
